title: With Priests Scarce in Rural Italy, an African Pastor Is Filling the Void
description: Immigrants have long eased labor shortages on farms and factories in Italy. But churches also need foreign-born priests, like the Rev. Vincent Souly of the Ivory Coast.

title: After Women in India Joined Protests, Online Harassment Followed
description: Widespread online abuse and visits from the police show the added risks women take standing up for their beliefs in a patriarchal society.

title: Rescuers search for survivors of powerful Indonesia earthquake
description: Officials say a rapid assessment into the impact of the earthquake that destroyed hundreds of buildings and killed 47 is under way.

title: Climbing stairs linked to dramatically lower risk of dying from heart disease
description: A simple daily habit may be linked to a dramatically lower risk of premature death, particularly from heart disease — no gym membership required.

title: Former Bernie Sanders operative warns radical left has ‘overtaken’ the Democratic Party from within

title: Va. State shooting: Suspect arrested, found hiding in dorm closet, police say

title: Australia gun buyback spurred by Bondi attack to start in November, PM says
